Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Subramonium Prasad
 Order
% 10.09.2024 CRL.M.A. 27307/2024 (Exemption) Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
1. This is an application on behalf of the Appellant for condonation of delay.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, the delay of 80 days in filing the appeal is condoned.
3. The application is disposed of.

1. The Appellant has approached this Court challenging Judgment dated 26.02.2024 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge convicting the Appellant in FIR No.139/2012 dated 09.08.2009 registered at Police Station Gokalpuri for offences under Section 304B & 498A IPC.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/09/2024 at 08:38:03 2.

Vide a separate Order on Sentence dated 23.04.2024, the Appellant has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years for offences punishable under Section 304B IPC with fine of Rs.50,000/-.
For offences punishable under Section 498A IPC, the Appellant has been sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for a period of two years with fine of Rs.20,000/-.
In default of payment of fine, the Appellant shall further undergo simple imprisonment for a period of three months.
